claims.claim: All kia and Hyundai genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used.
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a loose car windshield/glass panel; no make/model compatibility or part listing is readable.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: No Toyota branding/part number/markings are readable on the glass in the witness report.
Witness report does not mention cracks/chips; it only notes tinted/dark glass with reflections and orange trim along an edge.
Witness report shows only the windshield/glass panel lying indoors; no clips/brackets/hardware are shown.

risks.risk: Wrong fit/compatibility (windshield shape/size and mounting points differ by exact model/year/trim).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the glass markings/part number (etched/printed) and/or the vehicle VIN/fitment chart, plus a measurement shot (height/width) and edge/mounting hole/clip positions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used windshield with unknown fitment risk (assume may not fit).

risks.risk: Hidden damage (micro-cracks, chips at edges, scratches) not visible due to reflections/tint.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of the entire glass under direct light from multiple angles (including all four corners and the orange-trim edge), plus a video pan across the surface.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/unknown condition (assume may have defects).

risks.risk: Not genuine / counterfeit (Toyota vs China copy) because markings/part number are not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of any OEM markings, manufacturer stamp, DOT/E-marking, and the exact part number; receipt/box label if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified origin (assume worst-case: not OEM).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/hardware (seals, brackets, clips, mounting gasket) needed for installation.
risks.proof: Photo of all included parts laid out (clips/brackets/seal/gasket) and a shot showing the windshield with its included hardware.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as glass-only with no guaranteed included hardware.

risks.risk: Type mismatch (tempered vs laminated) and safety compliance not confirmed.
risks.proof: Clear photo of any glass type markings and part number; close-up of any etched safety text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown glass type (assume worst-case for safety/compliance uncertainty).

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of any etched/printed markings on the windshield (OEM part number, manufacturer stamp, DOT/E-marking).
Send photos showing the full windshield edges and all corners (especially around the orange trim) under bright light with minimal reflections.
Send a photo/video confirming there are no cracks/chips by scanning the entire surface and edges.
Send photos of any included seals, clips, brackets, and mounting hardware laid out clearly.
Provide the exact vehicle fitment (make/model/year/trim) or VIN match, and a measurement photo (height/width) for confirmation.
response.reason: The witness confirms only a loose tinted windshield/glass panel with orange trim, but key pricing drivers (fitment, OEM authenticity, crack-free condition, and included hardware) are not verifiable from the report. Proof is needed before a reliable price can be set.
